activate_mansion_switch.description: Interacts with Mewtwo Statue 2 at (2, 11) on 2F West from (2, 12) facing UP to successfully toggle the gate state to State B. It outputs a sequence of 'A' presses and sleeps to bypass auto-advance dialogue without silently selecting NO.
activate_mansion_switch.python_script:
# Let's output a sequence of 'A' presses with pauses to toggle Mewtwo Statue 2.
# Default cursor is YES, so we just press A.
import json

# Output the sequence
print(json.dumps(["A", "sleep 1500", "A", "sleep 1500", "A", "sleep 1500", "A"]))
